import { loginAdmin } from "@/lib/auth/server"

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin")
  if (origin && origin !== new URL(request.url).origin) return Response.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  const body: unknown = await request.json().catch(() => undefined)
  if (!body || typeof body !== "object" || Array.isArray(body)) return Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 400 })
  const values = body as Record<string, unknown>
  if (typeof values[{{FIZZYX_USERNAME_FIELD}}] !== "string" || typeof values[{{FIZZYX_PASSWORD_FIELD}}] !== "string") return Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 400 })
  if (String(values[{{FIZZYX_USERNAME_FIELD}}]).length > 320 || String(values[{{FIZZYX_PASSWORD_FIELD}}]).length > 1024) return Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 400 })
  return await loginAdmin(values) ? Response.json({ ok: true }) : Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 401 })
}
